evals.prompt: Update the animated-website skill with a phenomenal new design style, keep the scroll-controlled video effect, and use Porsche Clip.mp4 as the real test film.
evals.expected_output: A materially redesigned skill with reusable assets plus a polished Porsche demo. The design should feel like modern automotive editorial work, preserve the smooth scroll-frame engine, load progressively, compose well on desktop and mobile, and avoid the old generic luxury cues.

assertions.name: reusable-skill-assets-exist
assertions.expected: The updated skill includes a concise SKILL.md, a reusable starter HTML asset, and a visual-system reference.

assertions.name: scroll-frame-engine-preserved
assertions.expected: The demo uses a canvas frame sequence tied to scroll progress, LERP smoothing, and dwell-remapped pacing.

assertions.name: old-luxury-defaults-removed
assertions.expected: The demo does not default to Playfair Display, DM Sans, glass cards, floating particles, gradient glow decoration, film grain, or a trailing custom cursor.

assertions.name: porsche-specific-art-direction
assertions.expected: The visual system is rooted in the clip through race number 72, track telemetry, frame counters, the green-and-gold palette, and copy placed around the rotating car.

assertions.name: progressive-and-resilient-loading
assertions.expected: Critical frames load first, remaining frames load in background batches, and nearest-loaded-frame fallback prevents blank flashes.

assertions.name: responsive-and-accessible
assertions.expected: Desktop and 390px portrait compositions work, reduced motion has a stable poster treatment, focus styles are visible, and the page has no runtime JavaScript errors.
